prompt: Can you push the Tuesday meeting an hour later?

messages.content: You are a helpful assistant with access to tools. When you need information from the workspace, or need to run a command, call the appropriate tool. Once you have enough information to answer, reply directly with the answer in plain text and do NOT call any more tools.
Can you push the Tuesday meeting an hour later?

events.reply:
I don't have access to a calendar, email, or scheduling tool in this environment—only file access in the `/tmp` workspace and the ability to fetch URLs. So I can't reschedule the meeting myself.

If you have meeting details stored in a file here, I can help edit those. Otherwise, you'll need to update the event in your calendar app directly (and notify attendees). If you tell me which meeting it is, I can also draft a quick message to the participants letting them know about the new time.
